Name: Automove
Author: mystkeen
Description:
[b][size=6]Intro[/size]
[/b]
My farming journey started with Harvest Moon: Back to Nature.
There's a feature in that game that allows the farmer to walk forward when the player holds the circle button on the controller. This is something I missed in Stardew Valley from the begining, because it can be very tiring to walk around using the left thumbstick all the time.

With the release of the 10 years anniversary video by ConcernedApe, I got into the mood to play this game again but, when I did, the old problem resurfaced.
After searching around, I couldn't find a mod to do this the way I wanted, so I decided to do it myself.



[b][size=6]Install[/size][/b]

After installing SMAPI, just extract the contents of the zip file into the "Stardew Valley\Mods" directory



[size=6][b]Controls[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Controller[/size]
[/b]
[size=3][b]B[/b]: Toggle automove.[/size]
[size=3][b]Y[/b]: Open inventory instead of crafting.[/size]
[size=3][b]Left Thumbstick[/b]: Default movement behavior. Will interrupt automove to enable moving manually.
[b]DPad[/b]: Change the farmer's direction.[/size]

[b][size=4]Keyboard[/size]
[/b]
[size=3][b]R[/b]: Toggle automove.[/size]
[size=3][b]Space[/b]: Hold to move.
[b]Arrow keys[/b]: Change the farmer's direction.[/size]
[size=3][b]WASD[/b]: Default movement behavior. Won't interrupt automove, but allows to walk sideways while automove is on.[/size]

[b][size=4]Mouse[/size]
[/b]
[b]Cursor position[/b]: Changes the farmer's direction when automove is enabled.
[b]Middle button (wheel)[/b]: Toggle automove.

Downloads.Description: Added an option to toggle automove using the middle mouse button (wheel).

Manifest.Name: Automove
Manifest.Description: Make the player move ahead while a button is pressed
